result.title: In-Context Estimation and Prediction for Parametric ODEs
result.summary: Transformers have demonstrated the ability to perform in-context learning, that is, to adapt to new tasks from a few examples without updating their parameters. Existing theory has largely focused on emulating gradient-based algorithms for convex statistical problems or establishing general function approximation guarantees without exploiting the underlying statistical structure. We study in-context parameter estimation and trajectory prediction for parametric ordinary differential equations (ODEs), where estimation is generally nonconvex. Under suitable identifiability and regularity conditions, we construct a transformer that estimates unknown system parameters from noisy trajectory observations through a two-stage approximate maximum likelihood procedure: a coarse search provides an initialization within a locally strongly convex region, followed by gradient descent with local linear contraction. For prediction, we compose this estimator with a neural approximation of the ODE solution map. We further show that, through parameter sharing, a single transformer can perform both parameter estimation and trajectory prediction simultaneously. For these constructions, we establish nonasymptotic guarantees and finite-pretraining oracle inequalities that separate errors due to finite pretraining data, finite context length, and finite-sized transformer approximation. Numerical experiments on linear and nonlinear ODEs further show that pretrained transformers can benefit from longer inference contexts without updating their weights.

AI.brief_summary: 研究 transformer 对参数化 ODE 的 in-context 参数估计与轨迹预测：构造模型以两阶段近似极大似然（粗搜索初始化后接局部梯度下降）从含噪轨迹中估参，再与 ODE 解映射的神经近似组合，并通过参数共享让单个 transformer 同时完成估计与预测，给出非渐近保证与划分预训练数据、上下文长度和模型容量误差的 oracle 不等式。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉多模态推理无直接关联，但其「在上下文中迭代精化连续隐变量估计」的构造及对上下文长度、预训练量与容量误差的分解，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态的循环更新与长度泛化预测线索。
